title: Whatever He wanted He did in the heavens: the small face holds all of the big one
overview:
Chapter 33 gathers the chain of the previous chapters into one *hisbonenus* (contemplation), from all the particulars to the one whole: "whatever *Havaya* wanted, He did in the heavens." The essential desire for kindness comes down through the *Kav*, *Adam Kadmon*, *Atik*, *Arich* and *Abba* to the outer vessels of *netzach* and *hod* of *Zeir Anpin*, and it is all at once, as a person's inner will is felt at once in his beating heart, because He, His life force and His vessels are one.

*Zeir Anpin* is the small face and *Arich* the big face, like a baby who wants a lollipop and an old rabbi: both are a person, built the same way. Like an exact globe of the earth, the small one lacks nothing; it is only small. So the three *Adams* of *Beriya*, *Yetzira* and *Asiya*, and so "his name is *MaH* and his son's name is *MaH*." Along the way the class asks where *Abba* fits, hears that the goal of contemplation is the *middos*, which are wills, and that *taanug* means consciousness, not pleasure, and ends with the Gemara's *botzin botzin*.

sections.title: From the essential desire for kindness down to the outer vessels of the heart
sections.summary: Whatever *Havaya* wanted, He did in the heavens: the desire rooted in the essential *chafetz chesed* comes down the whole chain, through *Adam Kadmon*, *Atik*, *Arich* and *Abba*, to the outer vessels of *netzach* and *hod* of *Zeir Anpin*, where the light of the simple will ends.

phrases.he: (לג) ובכל זה יובן ענין ההתבוננות אחת מן רבוי כל הפרטים אל כלל א' הכוללם יחד והוא כמו כל אשר חפץ יהו״ה עשה בשמים ובארץ כו', שחפץ יהו״ה זה הרי שרשו במקור הראשון (שנקרא יחיד כו') הוא בחינת חפץ חסד ההיולי העצמי שבעצמות אור אין סוף הפשוט בתכלית, כטבע הטוב והחסד העצמי הנטוע בעצם הנפש (כמו שכתוב באות יו''ד) וכאשר עלה רצון וחפץ יהו״ה להטיב בדרך פרט מכללות אור ההיולי הזה, ירד ברבוי השתלשלות בעצמותו עדיין בבחינת אין סוף, עד שבא זה הרצון לבחינת נצח והוד בחיצוניות כלי הלב
דהיינו חיצוניות מדות שבמלכות דאין סוף,
phrases.en: In other words, it's talking now *b'chitzoniyus kli halev* of *Ein Sof*.

phrases.he: הגם ששם למעלה מעלה מבחינת הגבלת אורות בכלים כו'
phrases.en: Even though over there really you can't really say this, because there's no such thing up there as *oros* and *kelim* altogether,

phrases.he: אלא הכל בבחינת אין סוף ממש
כששיער בעצמו כו'
phrases.en: and the thing of the *glif glifu*.

blocks.text: The chapter opens with the *hisbonenus* (contemplation) that goes from all the particulars to the one whole: "whatever *Havaya* wanted, He did in the heavens." The essential *chafetz chesed* (desire for kindness) comes down the whole chain to *netzach* and *hod* in the outer vessels of the heart. **In other words, it's talking now *b'chitzoniyus kli halev* of *Ein Sof***. Up there one cannot really speak of lights and *kelim* (vessels) at all: it is all *Ein Sof* *mamash*. But once you can say *sefiros* there, you can already say the whole thing, with the *partzufim* and the *glif glifu*.

phrases.he: ואחר כך נתצמצם וירד על ידי בחינת קו בעשר ספירות דעגולים כו', עד בחינת כתר דאדם קדמון,
שהוא מקור הרצון הנעלם שבא לידי גלוי רצון לרצון בכתר דעתיק יומין כו'
phrases.en: The *ratzon hane'lam*, which comes into the *gilui* of the *ratzon l'ratzon* in the regular *ratzon* and *taanug* in *Keser* of *Atik*.

phrases.he: עד בחינת רצון ותענוג שבאבא ואמא שמתצמצמים
ברצון ושכל והשגה,
phrases.en: means *Keser*, *chachma* and *bina*,

phrases.he: ג׳ ראשין דחכמה ובינה כו'
phrases.en: the *chachma* and *bina*.

phrases.he: עד בחינת מדות ז׳ תחתונים דבינה
עד בחינת קטנות מוחין דנה''י דאבא ואמא בזעיר אנפין
phrases.en: Till the *katnus hamochin* of *Nehi* which becomes the *mochin* of *Zeir Anpin*,

phrases.he: כנזכר לעיל

blocks.text: Then it came down through the *Kav* (line) to *Keser* of *Adam Kadmon*. **The *ratzon hane'lam*, which comes into the *gilui* of the *ratzon l'ratzon***, is revealed in the will and delight of *Keser* of *Atik*, in *Radla*. From there, through *Malchus* of *Arich*, it becomes *Keser*, *chachma* and *bina* of *Abba*, then the seven lower *middos* of *bina*, and **the *katnus hamochin* of *Nehi* which becomes the *mochin* of *Zeir Anpin***.

phrases.he: ומשם מתצמצם עוד בג' מדריגות דחב''ד חג''ת דזעיר אנפין כו',
עד בחינת חיצוניות הכלים דנצח והוד שבבחינת הבל החזה כו'
שם מסתיים אור הרצון הפשוט שהיה כלול בהעלם עצמות חפץ חסד ההיולי כו'

blocks.text: From there it is contracted further, through *Chabad* and *Chagas* of *Zeir Anpin*, to the outer vessels of *netzach* and *hod* at the *hevel hachaze* (the breath of the chest). It all happens in a person too. There the light of the simple will, which was included in the hidden essential *chafetz chesed*, ends. That is why all of it is called *Elokus* (G-dliness), and *Beriya*, *Yetzira* and *Asiya* are already called separate.

sections.title: All at once: He, His life force and His vessels are one
sections.summary: The whole chain is drawn down at once, as a person's inner will is felt at once in his heart and lungs, because *ihu v'chayohi v'garmohi chad*. Even the vessels of *Zeir Anpin* are still *Ein Sof*: they are only the power to limit, and their end is wedged in the head of *Adam Kadmon*.

phrases.he: והרי מכל רבוי פרטי ההשתלשלות הזאת, נעשה ונמשך
בבת אחת
phrases.en: immediately,

phrases.he: מרצון שעלה בהעלם העצמות עד שבא במורגש
בהבל הלב,
phrases.en: till the lungs.

phrases.he: משום דאיהו וחיוהי וגרמוהי חד
phrases.en: Because He and His life force and His *kelim* and His body is all one thing.

blocks.text: From all the many particulars of this chain, the drawing down happens at once, **immediately**, as in a person: from his inner will to his outer heart it is immediate, all the way to the lungs. *Ihu v'chayohi v'garmohi chad*: **He and His life force and His *kelim* and His body is all one thing**, *mamash* one, with no differentiation. A person immediately feels an inner emotion in his heart beating faster and his lungs breathing faster or slower.

phrases.he: פירוש איהו, בחינת עצמות אור אין סוף ממש, וחיוהי, בחינת עשר ספירות דהעלם וגלוי, כשלהבת כו'
עד עשר ספירות דזעיר אנפין כו'
וגרמוהי, בחינת הכלים דזעיר אנפין
חד,
phrases.en: It's all one thing.

phrases.he: הכל בבחינת אין סוף עדיין

blocks.text: *Ihu* is the Essence of the infinite light *mamash*; *chayohi* is the ten *sefiros* of the light, hidden and revealed, down to the ten *sefiros* of *Zeir Anpin*; *garmohi* is the vessels of *Zeir Anpin*. *Chad*: **it's all one thing**. All of it is still *Ein Sof*, even the *kelim*.

phrases.he: כי גם שבחינת הכלים, המגבילים למדות חיצוניות דלב זעיר אנפין, הן בתכלית הקטנות לגבי ערך רוממות עצמות המדות שבבחינת מלכות דאין סוף, מכל מקום נחשב בחינת סוף לראש, וכמו שכתוב קורא הדורות מראש כו'
וסיומן בסוף הוא בבחינת קטנות המדות דזעיר אנפין

blocks.question: How can the vessels be *Ein Sof*?
blocks.text: Even though the vessels that limit the outer *middos* of *Zeir Anpin* are utterly small beside the essential *middos* in *Malchus* of *Ein Sof*, they still count as the end joined to the head. And as was said before, the *kelim* of *Zeir Anpin* are not an actual *gvul* (limit) but the power to limit, like the eye. The eye can really see infinite things; it is a power to bring them down to a limit. So are the vessels.

Their being called *katnus* (smallness) is the smallness of end against head, compared to the *Atzmus* of *Ein Sof*. As far as we are concerned, it is all still *Ein Sof*. "He calls the generations from the head": from the head of *Adam Kadmon*. The *sefiros* of *Zeir Anpin*, even their outside, the *kelim*, reach up to the head of *Adam Kadmon*, though their end is in the smallness of the *middos* of *Zeir Anpin*.

sections.title: The small face and the big face: a baby and an old rabbi
sections.summary: *Zeir Anpin* is the small personality and *Arich Anpin* the big one, as a baby is to an old sage: both are a person, with the same design, only one very small. *Arich* in turn is small beside *Adam Kadmon*: the three *Adams* of *Asiya*, *Yetzira* and *Beriya*, in each of which are ten *sefiros*.

phrases.he: ולכך נקרא זעיר אנפין
phrases.en: That's why it's called *Zeir Anpin*, little face.

phrases.he: קטנות הפנים,
phrases.en: Meaning the small personality.

blocks.text: So it is called *Zeir Anpin*, **little face**: *katnus hapanim*, **the small personality**. *Arich* means the big personality, and *Adam Kadmon* is called *Arich d'Arich*, because it is *ratzon l'ratzon*: *Arich* is the will, *Adam Kadmon* the will for the will. It is like the three kinds of letters, regular, small and big. *Arich* is big compared to *Zeir Anpin* but small compared to *Adam Kadmon*.

phrases.he: כאנפי זוטרי
phrases.en: like a little face,

phrases.he: דתינוק קטן
phrases.en: like the little tiny personality of a little baby

phrases.he: לגבי בחינת אנפי רברבי,
phrases.en: like a big guy,

phrases.he: זקן שקנה חכמה כו'
phrases.en: meaning the sophistication of an old rabbi compared to the sophistication of a little baby.

phrases.he: שזה תכלית הקטנות במוחין,
וזה תכלית הגדלות
phrases.en: and the old rabbi is *tachlis hagadlus*.

phrases.he: מכל מקום משתווים בערך אדם,
phrases.en: But nonetheless, they're both a person.

phrases.he: רק שזה נקרא אדם קטן וזה נקרא אדם הגדול כו',
phrases.en: This a little guy and he's a big guy.

phrases.he: אבל ציור אופניו אחד הוא
phrases.en: The *tziyur ofanim* is the same thing.

phrases.he: כי בקטן מדותיו גם כן על פי שכל ורצון הנעלם כו',
phrases.en: It also works exactly the same way, really,

phrases.he: רק שבא בתכלית הקטנות מאד
phrases.en: but it comes in a very small way.

phrases.he: ובאדם הגדול מדותיו גדולים על פי רוחב שכלו ורצונו הרמה והנשגבה ביותר כו'

blocks.title: The baby and the old rabbi
blocks.text: The little face of a small baby against the big face of an elder who has acquired wisdom: **the sophistication of an old rabbi compared to the sophistication of a little baby**. The baby is the utmost *katnus* of mind; about all he can think about is that he wants a lollipop. The old rabbi is the utmost *gadlus* (greatness).

**But nonetheless, they're both a person**, a small one and a great one, with the same *tziyur ofanim*: each has a brain, emotions and a body. A child's *middos* also follow intellect and a hidden will; **it also works exactly the same way, really, but it comes in a very small way**, so he can only think about little things. The great man's *middos* are as great as the breadth of his intellect and will.

phrases.he: כך ערך קטנות המדות דזעיר אנפין, שהם המדות שמצומצמין בקטנות השכל דנצח והוד כו', לגבי בחינת אריך אנפין שנקרא אנפי רברבי
גדלות הפנים
והמוחין דזקן שקנה חכמה ממקור החכמה הנעלמה,
phrases.en: Not just a regular smart guy, but a wise sage who has not just a *chachma*, but the *mekor hachachma*.

phrases.he: שלמעלה מקרומא כו'
שהוא בחינת שכל הנעלם שברצון הנעלם כו', שהוא שרש הנאצלים כו'

blocks.text: So are the small *middos* of *Zeir Anpin*, contracted into the small intellect of *netzach* and *hod*, that is, coming after the intellect, compared to *Arich Anpin*, the big face. Its *mochin* are those of an elder who acquired wisdom from its hidden source. **Not just a regular smart guy, but a wise sage who has not just a *chachma*, but the *mekor hachachma*** (the source of wisdom): the hidden intellect in the hidden will.

phrases.he: וכן גם המדות שברצון ושכל הנעלם דאריך אנפין, הוא בבחינת קטנות הערך
לגבי בחינת אדם הגדול יותר,
phrases.en: The super big guy.

phrases.he: והוא בחינת אדם קדמון שנקרא אדם דבריאה כו'
(וכידוע דזעיר אנפין נקרא אדם דעשיה ואריך אנפין נקרא אדם דיצירה ואדם קדמון אדם דבריאה

blocks.text: And the *middos* in the hidden will and intellect of *Arich Anpin* are small in turn, compared to a greater man still, **the super big guy**: *Adam Kadmon*, called *Adam d'Beriya*. These are the three *Adams*, *Adam d'Beriya*, *Adam d'Yetzira* and *Adam d'Asiya*: the little guy, the big guy and the super big guy. *Zeir Anpin* is *Adam d'Asiya*, *Arich Anpin* *Adam d'Yetzira*, *Adam Kadmon* *Adam d'Beriya*, all in the general worlds.

blocks.question: Where does *Abba* fit into this?
blocks.text: It does not fit into this: these are wills, and the order skips. There is *Atik*, then a will, then intellect, then a will. There is the essential will and *Atika d'Atikin*; in the *machshava stima'a* (hidden thought) of *Adam Kadmon* there is a level of delight, then a level of will. The levels of delight, and *Abba*, are conduits.

blocks.question: Is *Abba* part of *Zeir Anpin* or of *Arich*?
blocks.text: *Abba* is part of *Zeir Anpin*, of *Adam d'Asiya*: it comes after *Arich*, which is higher than *Abba*. It is called the *mochin* of *Zeir Anpin*. Those are only its small *mochin*, but there is also a *gadlus hamochin* (full mind) of *Zeir Anpin*, which is *mamash* *Abba* himself. That is the outside of *Abba*; the inside of *Abba* is in *Arich*. So *Abba* is a link.

The link brings from the inner *Abba*, the *mochin* of *Arich*, to the *mochin* of *Zeir Anpin*. The inner *Abba* goes higher still, to the inner *Atik*, which is the inner *Arich*, for in *Arich* too there are small and great *mochin*. *Atik* works the same way between *Adam Kadmon* and *Arich*: as was said, the *chesed* of *chesed* of *Atik* is in the *gulgalta* (skull).

blocks.question: If there are *Adam Kadmon* and *Arich*, where is *Atik*?
blocks.text: *Atik* is part of *Arich*. And *Abba* is part of *Atzilus*, which is the *Asiya* of the general worlds. But it depends which *Abba* you mean: the *Abba* of *Atzilus* is the outer *Abba*, while the inner *Abba*, the *mocha stima'a* (hidden brain), is in *Arich*, higher than *Atzilus*. The whole point of *Abba* is to bring the inner *mochin* to the outer *mochin*: it is the interface.

But the real thing is *davka* the *middos*. One may ask: your whole *shita* (approach) says the main thing is *hisbonenus*. Yes, the main method is *hisbonenus*; the main goal is *davka* the *middos*. The test of *hisbonenus* is whether it improves your *middos*, and the *middos* are wills.

The *middos* are the smallness of the will. Love, fear, *netzach*: all wills. To love something means you want it; to hate something means you want it to stay away from you. *Netzach* is a will to win; *hoda'a* (acknowledging) is giving in to somebody else's will. *Yesod* is the middle line, *mamash* connected to the essence of the will, to *Keser*: the will of the receiver for the giver and of the giver for the receiver. *Malchus* is a will to rule, *Ana Emloch*. *Chachma* and *bina* are a different thing: one says it is a will for wisdom, but it is not really; wisdom is another *inyan* than will.

So with *taanug* (delight). Delight and will are *mamash* the same thing, yet a different *inyan*, so different that when you are having the delight, the will disappears. Chassidus explains in various places that delight is the real inner side of *chachma*, and wisdom comes from delight, as in "a man's wisdom lights up his face." The reason: the real translation of *taanug* into philosophical English is consciousness, not pleasure.

A lot of people think *taanug* means pleasure, and since there is nothing higher than pleasure, let's go out and enjoy ourselves. That is not what it means. It means consciousness, the inner side of intellect.
These are the conduits between the wills. Between the will of *Adam Kadmon* and the revealed will, the conduit is *Atik*; between *Arich* and *Zeir Anpin*, the conduit is *Abba* and *Ima*.

phrases.he: ובכל אחד יש עשר ספירות בהעלם וגלוי כו'
וכמו שכתוב לכבודי, שהוא מלכות דאין סוף, בראתיו – אדם קדמון, יצרתיו – עתיק יומין ואריך אנפין, אף עשיתיו – בחינת זעיר אנפין שנאמר בו, נעשה אדם בצלמינו כו')

blocks.text: In each of them are ten *sefiros*, hidden and revealed. As the verse says: "For My glory", *Malchus* of *Ein Sof*; "I created it", *Adam Kadmon*; "I formed it", *Atik Yomin* and *Arich Anpin*, so here the text itself puts *Atik* and *Arich* in *Adam d'Yetzira*. "I even made it" is *Zeir Anpin*, including its *mochin*, as it says "Let us make man": not *middos* without *mochin*. *Middos* without *mochin* is an animal.

sections.title: A perfect map of the earth: everything is there, only small
sections.summary: The small holds everything the big has, like an exact globe of the earth, like a baby's love and an old man's love, like a child born in his father's likeness. So the *middos* of *Atzilus* hold all of *Adam Kadmon*'s, from the greatest length to the greatest shortness, and both are called *MaH*.

phrases.he: והוא על דרך משל ציור קוין שעושין בקטנות לדבר גדול,
phrases.en: Like a *mashal* of when you make a little tiny picture of a big thing,

phrases.he: כמו דמיון המפה לכדור הארץ כו'
phrases.en: like a map, especially like a globe, to the actual earth.

phrases.he: שעם כל זה יש בציור זה הכל לא נעדר אפילו כקוצו של יו''ד כו',
רק שהוא בקטנות מאד,
phrases.en: Except it's very small.

phrases.he: ומה שמצוייר בו קו קטן בכדור הארץ הוא אורך נהר ת''ק פרסא
phrases.en: On the big one it's a river which is 500 miles long.

phrases.he: וכהאי גוונא כו'

blocks.title: The map and the globe
blocks.text: A *mashal*: a little tiny picture of a big thing, like a map, or better a globe, of the actual earth. Nothing in it is missing, not even the tip of a *yud*, if you could make a totally exact map. An ordinary map does not do it: look on a map of Los Angeles and ask where the tree in your backyard is. But say you could make it like those Chinese ivory elephants, a total map of everything with nothing missing, **except it's very small**. A little line on it is a river five hundred miles long on the big one.

phrases.he: וכך על דרך משל המדות דקטנות דתינוק לגבי מדות דזקן בן ע' כו'
וכמו כח המוליד בדומה לו כו'
phrases.en: And like the *koach hamolid*, meaning it's within the seed to put through all the exact things.

phrases.he: (וכמו שכתוב במקום אחר בענין בוצין בוצין כו')

blocks.text: So the *middos* of a small baby against those of a man of seventy: *mamash* the same *middos*. Happiness is happiness, sadness is sadness, love is love; a baby loves and an old man loves. **And like the *koach hamolid*** (the power of begetting): the seed carries all the exact things through. A Chinese man's child comes out with Chinese eyes. As it says elsewhere about *botzin botzin*, it comes out the same as the original.

blocks.title: Abaye and Rava point to Heaven
blocks.text: *Botzin botzin* is in the Gemara, *Berachos* 48a. Abaye and Rava, little children, were sitting before Rabba. He asked them: to whom do we say the blessing? To the Merciful One, they said. And where does the Merciful One sit? Rava pointed to the ceiling; Abaye went outside and pointed to the sky. Rabba said: both of you will grow up to be rabbis. As people say, *botzin botzin mikatfei yadia*.

blocks.text: Pumpkins are known from their sapling: as soon as you see the sapling you know what kind of plant it is going to be. Even though it is small, you can already see all of the big in it. It is exactly the same.
blocks.outOfPlace: Told at the end of the class (w2996 on), when asked where botzin botzin (line 37) is found; placed under the line it explains.

blocks.text: They did not know the song "Hashem is here, Hashem is there, Hashem is truly everywhere." But that is the whole thing: they were little children and they said the right thing, so it was known they would be rabbis.

phrases.he: וכך הוא בחינת המדות דאדם דאצילות, דגם שבאים בצמצום היותר אחרון לגבי בחינת המדות דאדם קדמון ואריך אנפין כו',
אבל מכל מקום הכל אחד,
phrases.en: Everything that's there is there,

phrases.he: רק שבא מן בחינת האריכות היותר מופלג אל הקיצור היותר מופלג
phrases.en: from tremendous bigness to tremendous smallness.

blocks.text: So are the *middos* of the *Adam* of *Atzilus*. This does not mean something above *Adam Kadmon*, as though *Adam Kadmon* were *Adam d'Beriya* and *Atzilus* higher still: it means *Atzilus* itself. Though its *middos* come in the last *tzimtzum* compared to those of *Adam Kadmon* and *Arich Anpin*, it is all one: *mamash* **everything that's there is there**, only it goes **from tremendous bigness to tremendous smallness**.

phrases.he: (וזה שכתוב מה שמו מה שם בנו
– מה שמו, מ''ה דאדם קדמון – מה שם בנו, בחינת זעיר אנפין
phrases.en: His name is *MaH*, the *middos* of *Adam Kadmon*, and his son's name is also *MaH*: the name of *Zeir Anpin* is also *MaH*.

phrases.he: כו' וכמו שכתוב בכמה דוכתי)

blocks.text: "What is his name, and what is his son's name?" **His name is *MaH***, the Name of forty-five, **the *middos* of *Adam Kadmon***, and his son's name, *Zeir Anpin* and its *Nukva*, is also *MaH*. How can both be called the same thing? Because both are *middos* and wills. Only there it is the infinite, total will, infinite even compared to *Arich Anpin*, and here it is in total smallness.

sections.title: The sum of the contemplation: what He wanted in the Essence He made in the heavens
sections.summary: Whatever *Havaya* wanted in the Essence, He did in the heavens of *Zeir Anpin*, because their beginning is wedged in their end. That is the *yichuda ila'a*; then the whole thing repeats as the *yichuda tata'a*, from the *middos* of *Atzilus* to the physical heavens, as the rest of the book explains.

phrases.he: והיינו כללות ההתבוננות בכל אשר חפץ יהו״ה בעצמות אור אין סוף ממש, עשה בשמים שהוא בחינת זעיר אנפין
אש ומים – חסד וגבורה דקטנות דאצילות כו'
(עד בחינת שמים דעשיה)

blocks.text: This is the whole of the contemplation: whatever *Havaya* wanted in the Essence of the infinite light *mamash*, He did in the heavens, *Zeir Anpin*, fire and water, the *chesed* and *gevura* of the smallness of *Atzilus*, down to the heavens of *Asiya*. Here he slips in the rest of the book, chapter 34 onward: this is the first unification, through *Atzilus*; then the whole thing starts over from *Malchus* of *Atzilus*, as a new thing, with a new *Beriya*, *Yetzira* and *Asiya* of smallness, all the way down to *Asiya*.

phrases.he: לפי שנעוץ תחלתן בסופן, מחכמה בראש דאדם קדמון עד חכמה בסוף מדות דזעיר אנפין
(וזה שכתוב ברוך יהו״ה אלה״י ישראל סבא, בחינת אדם קדמון שנאמר בו בראתיו כו'
וכן שמע ישראל כו' שהוא בי''ע שבכללות)

blocks.text: For their beginning is wedged in their end, from the *chachma* at the head of *Adam Kadmon* to the *chachma* at the end of the *middos* of *Zeir Anpin* and *Nukva*. So the verse "Blessed is *Havaya*, the G-d of Israel" means *Yisroel Saba*, *Adam Kadmon*, and "Hear, O Israel" is *Beriya*, *Yetzira* and *Asiya* of the general worlds. Asked whether "Hear, O Israel, *Havaya* is our G-d, *Havaya* is One" is then the *yichuda ila'a* (the higher unity), he agrees: it is the general *Beriya*, *Yetzira* and *Asiya*.

phrases.he: (ודרך פרט יותר, הרי כל אשר חפץ יהו״ה במדות דאצילות, עשה בשמים וארץ דבי''ע, עד בחינת מזלות דגלגלים הגשמיים,
שרש השפעת דומם צומח חי ומדבר הגשמיים
כמו שיתבאר בעזרת השם) :
phrases.en: Like will be explained in the rest of the book.

blocks.text: And in a more particular way: whatever *Havaya* wanted in the *middos* of *Atzilus*, He did in the heavens and earth of *Beriya*, *Yetzira* and *Asiya*, down to the *mazalos* (constellations) of the physical spheres, the root of the flow to the physical mineral, plant, animal and man. So it applies two ways: once as the *yichuda ila'a*, and then the whole thing repeats itself as the *yichuda tata'a* (the lower unity), all the way to the actual physical sky of this earth, **like will be explained in the rest of the book**. What came before was basically the *yichuda ila'a*.

reviewQuestions.question: How does a person show that the whole chain, from the hidden will to the outer vessels of the heart, is drawn down at once?
If the vessels of *Zeir Anpin* limit, how can they still be *Ein Sof*?
How are a baby and an old rabbi different, and what do they share?
Where does *Abba* fit among the three *Adams*?
What does an exact globe of the earth show about the *middos* of *Atzilus*?
In what two ways does "whatever *Havaya* wanted, He did in the heavens" apply?

notes.text: Tape 051 (Tape36-Side1), between chapter 32's 050 and this tape, is filed under chapter 32 in data/classes.txt ("051 Tape36-Side1 CH32") and reads no line: it is free discussion of letters, tevuna and Malchus (chapter 32 material). It is not part of this file; this chapter has only class 052, which reads all 46 lines.
Most lines are read in Hebrew without an English rendering; their phrases have no `en`. Only his English renderings are kept.
The question at w547-560 ("Why? What do you mean? So how are the kelim if they're Ein Sof?") may be a listener's; with no speaker labels it is written as his own (askedBy teacher).

On where Abba fits (w1359-1398) he first agrees with the listener that Abba is part of Adam d'Yetzira, then corrects himself: "No, no, it's not. It's part of Adam d'Asiya." The block has the final version.
At w2329 he names someone ("where is Ami walking around?") as the thing a map does not show; left out of the text.
The text has a river of 500 parsa; he says "500 miles". The block and phrase keep his words.

Berachos 48a: the transcript has "אמר להו רבא" (w3101) for the one who blesses the children; in the Gemara it is Rabba, who asked them, and the block says Rabba. He gives the source himself ("Gemara Berachos 48a"), and it is right.
w2761-2821: "Now he sticks in the rest of the book, chapter 34 and onwards, and then he's saying not really": the "not really" is unclear and left out of the block.

w1709-1726: "If you're having hisbonenus and it doesn't improve your middos, meaning your ratzon..." breaks off unfinished; the avodah block states the evident point (the test of hisbonenus is the middos) without completing his sentence further.
"A man's wisdom lights up his face" is followed by a half-remembered verse ("ומלא ח-, what is it, ומלא חפצה לשמעתא", w2041-2054) that is left out.
